value.title: Phase 1: per-root hidden-directory opt-in
value.summary: One coder, tasks in order, every assertion pinned to a backpressure row.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: Work top to bottom; stop-and-ask o-prime on anything outside the fence.

value.title: Persist the opt-in: migration 0024 (worktrees.include_hidden boolean not null default false), store read/write, /roots body + RootReport field, CLI `add --include-hidden/--no-include-hidden`

value.receipt: migration 0024 + persisted bool + optional /roots field + RootReport field + CLI include/no-include flags; targeted tests green; column-write mutation red then restored green

value.title: Thread the flag into discovery at roots.rs:178 and watch.rs:275 (`global OR per-root`); keep the .git refusal
value.success: opted-in root discovers dot-directory files on scan, re-add and watcher rescan; default root does not; .git never
value.receipt: root scan resolves global OR persisted per-root; watcher re-reads stored policy per subtree rescan; opted-in/default/.git/deny fixtures and two independent call-site mutations proven

value.title: Skip ledger `hidden` reason + status/tree surfacing
value.success: default add of a root with dot-dirs reports hidden=N; status --json and tree show include_hidden per root
value.receipt: manual hidden pruning names dot directories without descending; skip ledger aggregates hidden reason; status and tree expose the per-root bool in JSON and human output; targeted tests and mutation proven
